has couple event

  • CURIE: gmeow:hasCoupleEvent
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasCoupleEvent
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/genealogy

Relates a couple relationship to an event in its history — the marriage, the divorce, an anniversary. The seam the GEDCOM projection walks: a marriage gmeow:Event's gmeow:eventTime / gmeow:eventLocation source gedcom:date / gedcom:place on the couple's Marriage node. Non-functional: a couple bears several events.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:CoupleRelationship -> gmeow:Event

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:hasCoupleEvent from gmeow:CoupleRelationship to gmeow:Event when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:CoupleRelationship, gmeow:Event
